post.description:

listing_id.description:
Lot id from `search_auction_lots` / `get_sale_catalog` (e.g. 260436153).

Provider reference: minimum 1.

listing_type.description:
Which listing family the id belongs to; ignored when `url` is given.

Provider reference: allowed values ["upcoming", "results"]; default "upcoming".

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
One AuctionTime lot by id (or pasted URL): title, year/make/model, serial, condition, category, grouped specs, every photo, seller company and location, and the auction snapshot (end time, time remaining, current bid, bid count, next bid, starting bid, increment, grouped lots). Unknown ids are `not_found`. Auction-results pages hide the final price from anonymous visitors; `auction.price_requires_login` says so.

The response contains the tool result directly.

post.description:
Discover auction dates and standalone sales; take `event_id` into `get_sale_catalog`.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
Usage-based billing; Default request estimate: $0.0005 USD (not a fixed price). Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

date.description: Only this calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD). Not-found when the calendar has no such date. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

include_weekly_sellers.description: Include the per-seller rows of each weekly sale (hundreds of rows on busy dates). Off by default to keep the response small.

limit.description:
Return only the first N auction dates (chronological). Omit for the whole calendar.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 100.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
The AuctionTime upcoming-auctions calendar: every scheduled date with its lot count, the weekly AuctionTime sale (title, start time, optional per-seller rows) and the standalone single-seller sales ending that day (event id, auctioneer, location, UTC start/end, item count, catalog and live-board URLs).

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `count` | number | Auction dates returned. |
| `dates` | object[] |  |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `source_url` | string |  |
| `total_dates` | number | Auction dates on the calendar before `limit`/`date` filtering. |

post.description:
Find equipment lots to bid on or to look up; take `listing_id` into `get_auction_lot`. Use `list_categories` for category ids.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
Usage-based billing; Default request estimate: $0.0005 USD (not a fixed price). Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

category_id.description:
Numeric category id from `list_categories` or a category URL (e.g. 16044).

Provider reference: minimum 1.

listing_type.description:
`upcoming` = lots open or scheduled for bidding; `results` = closed lots (final bid amounts are login-only and not returned).

Provider reference: allowed values ["upcoming", "results"]; default "upcoming".

manufacturer.description: Manufacturer facet value, e.g. `CATERPILLAR` (case-insensitive on the site).

page.description:
1-based page; 28 lots per page.

Provider reference: minimum 1; default 1.

sort.description:
sort

Provider reference: allowed values ["best_match", "time_remaining", "price_asc", "price_desc", "year_asc", "year_desc", "hours_asc", "hours_desc", "manufacturer", "model", "serial_number", "stock_number", "recently_added", "recently_updated"]; default "best_match".

state.description: Full US state or Canadian province name as the site spells it, e.g. `Texas`. Two-letter codes return no results.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
Search AuctionTime lots (upcoming auctions or auction results) by keywords, category id, manufacturer, model and state, sorted and paginated 28 per page. Each lot carries its id, title, year/make/model, serial, category, lot number, auction end time, seller and first photo. Bid amounts are not on list pages (see `get_auction_lot`); auction-results final prices are login-only and never returned.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `category` | object | The selected category as the site resolves it; null for keyword-only searches. |
| `count` | number | Lots on this page. |
| `has_next` | boolean |  |
| `lots` | object[] |  |
| `next_page` | number | Next page number, or null on the last page. |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `page` | number |  |
| `page_size` | number | Fixed at 28 for anonymous visitors. |
| `query` | object |  |
| `source_url` | string |  |
| `total_count` | number | Total matching lots (`ListingsCount`). |
| `total_pages` | number |  |
